author: Yffe
content: Pin: forge/src/check.rs::mutation_score excludes a proven-EQUIVALENT survivor from BOTH the survivor set AND 'scored' ('REQ-2/REQ-4: excluded from BOTH the survivor set AND scored' — the equivalent += 1; continue branch after equivalence_proves_equal). So shipped denominator = attempted MINUS proven-equivalent, and shipped survivor set = Proved MINUS proven-equivalent. proof-backends.md §7 states 'The survivor set = Proved mutants ONLY' and 'The denominator = ATTEMPTED mutants (preserving the shipped behavior: today every generated-and-lowerable mutant is run, and the OQ-5 rule already DROPS un-lowerable mutants…)' — omitting the #101 equivalence drop entirely from the normative kill/denominator/floor rules (AC-7 and REQ-9 repeat 'denominator = attempted'). The 'preserving the shipped behavior' claim is therefore false as stated, and a literal increment-(iii) implementation regresses equivalent-mutant handling: equivalent mutants re-enter the denominator as survivors → spurious WeakContract floor failures. The doc's own §0 substrate bullet says mutation_score 'counts killed/scored/equivalent', so §7's restatement is internally inconsistent with §0 as well.
